hooks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command '& { $r = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; $m = Join-Path $r ".agents/managed.json"; $p = "scripts/project-hooks.ps1"; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $m) { $f = @((Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $m | ConvertFrom-Json).files | Where-Object source -EQ $p); if ($f.Count -ne 1) { exit 1 }; $p = $f[0].path }; & (Join-Path $r $p) -Root $r }'
